description: Save one thing to Taseli's memory of this business so every later decision follows it: the plan, the daily review, new ads and campaigns, every answer. Holds one lasting rule or preference ('always…', 'never…', 'I prefer…', 'from now on…', 'don't touch…'), a fact about the business that isn't in the business card (a new branch, a price, a season, a product they stopped selling), or a decision the owner made against advice. One note per call. Not for questions, passing remarks, or numbers that change daily. A setting Taseli already has (budget, target, goal, brand words, protected campaigns) is changed through a proposal the owner approves in Taseli; a note here holds only the reason behind it, if one was given. Changes nothing in any ad account.

account.description: An ad account's name, when it is about one account only; omit when it is about the whole business.

against_advice.description: Only for a decision against best practice: in one English line, what you advised and the expected cost, e.g. 'Advised keeping the brand campaign (about 30% of sales); owner turned it off.'

cost_note.description: With against_advice, in the chat: the expected cost in one short sentence in the owner's language. It is shown once as a quiet note under the saved line.

for_all_clients.description: Only for an agency's own team, for a preference: true when they state how the agency works for all its clients ('we always…', 'in all our accounts…', 'never for any client…'): naming, structure, bidding, budget and approval habits, creative tone, report format, never-do's (topic: agency.naming, agency.structure, agency.bidding, agency.budget, agency.approval, agency.creative, agency.report or agency.never). Saved in the agency's memory and followed in every client's account unless a client's own rule says otherwise. Not used for a rule about one business.

kind.description: fact: about the business. preference: how the owner wants things done. decision: a choice the owner made, also against advice.

quote.description: The owner's own words, as they wrote them (any language). Required when said_by_owner is true.

said_by_owner.description: true only when the owner said it outright in this conversation; false when it was inferred rather than said.

say.description: The same note, short, in the language of the conversation, as the owner would read it (shown to them and in Settings › What Taseli knows).

statement.description: One plain English line that stands on its own, e.g. 'Never run ads from Friday 16:00 to Saturday night (Shabbat).' or 'Haifa branch opened in October 2026; same services as Tel Aviv.'

topic.description: A short stable key, lowercase with dots, e.g. 'pref.shabbat', 'offer.price.cleaning', 'area.branches'. A later note with the same topic replaces this one, so reuse the topic when the owner changes their mind. 'pref.shabbat' notes add words only: the Shabbat hours themselves (and turning it off) are set in Settings › Notifications › Ads on Shabbat, so point the owner there for those.

name: remember

note.description: A plain note instead of data (nothing connected yet, not available here).

title: Remember for this business
